messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: multiple CUDA OOMs on node gpu-52. error rate up. auto-retries failing.

maya: looking. pods keep restarting with `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory` but `nvidia-smi` shows ~6GB free. starting node trace and container logs.

priya: heads-up to support: pausing scheduled enterprise batch jobs for cust-batch-42 and cust-analytics-1.

maya: node allocator snapshot:
```
total_mem: 33.28GB
reserved_bytes: 15.0GB
allocated_bytes: 24.5GB
spare_pool: 2 blocks (fragmented)
kv_cache_reserved: 8.0GB
headroom_reported: 5.9GB
```
reserved_bytes looks inconsistent with headroom+allocated.

julian: please paste reserve map counters + recent reserve_release logs.

maya: pasted trace to artifacts: https://internal-artifacts/redwood/gpu-52/allocator-trace-2067804500.log
snippet:
```
[2067804503] alloc_request size=512MB
[2067804503] reserve_alloc id=0x7e2.. size=1024MB
[2067804504] kv_evict owner=pod/kv-abc releasing 1024MB
[2067804504] reserve_release id=0x7e2.. COMMITTED
[2067804504] reserve_map shows id=0x7e2.. as ACTIVE  <-- race
[2067804505] alloc fails -> CUDA OOM
```

ashok: looks like a stale entry remained visible to the allocator due to non-atomic remove. double-counting reserved_bytes.

ops-runbook: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-oom-triage
recommended immediate actions: cordon, drain, evict-kv, route-off-node, increase spare pool.

maya: executing mitigations now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-52
kubectl drain gpu-52 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
curl -XPOST http://runtime-admin:8080/_admin/evict_kv_owners?node=gpu-52
curl -XPOST http://runtime-admin:8080/_admin/adjust_spare_pool?delta=1
route-mgr: set node.exclude=gpu-52 for impacted routes
```

sre-bot: cordon/drain in progress. notifying infra. 10m maintenance window.

priya: customer comms: low severity. two enterprise routes degraded; 5 failed jobs retried successfully. no SLA breach, sent updates.

maya: cores + logs uploaded: https://internal-artifacts/redwood/gpu-52/core-2067804505.tar.gz

julian: creating ticket RUNTIME-4521. fixes: make reserve_release atomic, add reconciliation GC, add metrics comparing reserve_map vs kv_cache_reserved, alert on spikes.

ashok: taking oncall handoff. node remains cordoned. will schedule hotfix and coordinate eng-runtime.

maya: timeline for postmortem notes:
- 2067804500 incident-bot alert
- 2067804502 pod OOM & restart
- 2067804503-2067804505 allocator race window
- 2067804510 cordon/drain
- 2067804525 kv eviction + spare pool bump
- 2067804540 routing change
- 2067804560 error-rate back to baseline

sre-bot: severity set Sev2. please file postmortem in 3 business days.

priya: updating support tickets and customer POCs. leaving notes in case log.

maya: thanks all :thumbsup: handing follow-up to @ashok and eng-runtime.
